title: Each repo names its mockup devices in order, and a mockup shows the first unless asked
why: Your word, Oct 26 23:52 CDT (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2NHAwYrKyU3AX4LqKSKG3Um): degen's mockups were all on a regular iPhone; they should default to the iPhone Duo folded (small screen), then unfolded (large), then a regular iPhone, and usually one is enough. Refinement, Oct 26 23:53 CDT (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2YazfDQj6vg4pRv1fgSyNcH): some repos are web apps, and your phones should not be repeated in each repo.
note: claude-settings defines your devices once (iPhone Duo folded, Duo unfolded, regular iPhone, desktop width) and a default order per app kind: iOS starts with the Duo folded, then unfolded, then regular iPhone; web starts with a phone width, then desktop. Each repo names only its app kind in its layout config, and lists devices only where it differs. The designer agent and skill design-explore read the resolved list; a mockup draws the first device only, the rest on request or when the layout breaks between them. The iOS standard (c91, skill ios-apps) names the iOS kind for your iOS repos (degen, mailaudit, home-app, ios-adblock); web repos name the web kind at their visit. Needs no answer. Port: yes; the devices and kinds are global, each repo names only its kind. Placed ahead of c93, after c109 (triage, Oct 27): both shape every blind brief, and c109's template names the device from this list.
